sentences.text: Mr. Hariom Rai, learned counsel for the petitioner states that he has given No Objection Certificate to the petitioner hence, he has no instruction in the matter.
On the basis of the order sheet, it transpires that the matter was listed on 11.12.2023, none has appeared on behalf of the petitioner and time was granted to the petitioner to remove the default.
4. Today also Mr. Hariom Rai has submitted that no instruction has been given to him to argue in the matter.

The matter has again been listed before this Court and none appears on behalf of the petitioner and the petitioner is not taking care in person or chosen any counsel to appear in the matter for removing the default pointed out by this Registry.
5. Considering the above facts, we dismiss the present petition with the liberty to petitioner to approach this Court by filing appropriate application if he is interested in contesting the matter.
6. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed with the aforementioned liberty.
